title: Useful Things
description: Useful Things is mod for minecraft and add some useful items/blocks.
body:
## English
Added some useful works to reduce game difficulty and enhance/enrich player gaming experience. At present, with spiritual energy (a resource) as the core and only a small number of works added, it is an informal version.

### For example:
1. Ling Qi Gatherer Machine: Collecting spiritual energy from the air.
2. Ling Qi Compression Machine: It can compress spiritual energy and liquid spiritual energy.
3. Time Warpper: It can accelerate blocks and solid blocks within a certain range, and can adjust the acceleration range and speed by itself. Need to consume FE, the higher the acceleration speed and the more blocks, the more FE is consumed.
4. Ling Qi Generator: It can consume spiritual energy, liquid spiritual energy, and spiritual energy ingots to generate electricity.
5. Components - machine upgrades：Can be used to upgrade some machines, but it will increase additional FE energy consumption.

## 中文
添加了一些有用的作品，用于降低游戏难度，提高/丰富玩家游戏体验。目前以灵气(一种资源)为核心,只添加了少量的作品,是非正式版。

### 例如：
1. 灵气采集器：采集空气中的灵气。
2. 灵气压缩器：可以将灵气、液态灵气压缩。
3. 时间扭曲器：可以加速一定范围内的方块，方块实体，可以自己调整加速范围和加速速度。需要消耗FE，加速速度越大，方块越多，消耗的FE越多。
4. 灵气发电机：可以消耗 灵气、液态灵气、灵气锭 发电。
5. 组件-机器升级：可以用于升级部分机器，但是会增加额外的FE能量消耗。
